(Cisco 1142 AP) :An '''[[IDT]]''' PCIe packet switch (IDT 89HPES3T3, [https://html.alldatasheet.com/html-pdf/198622/IDT/89HPES3T3/56/1/89HPES3T3.html link to '''IDT''' spec]) is used to provide the usage of multiple PCIe devices on the single host IF provided by the SoC. A C2PC made 07/01/2013 specifies... *The original wireless modules use AR9380 (2.4 GHz) and AR9390 (5 GHz). *These modules will be replaced with ones using AR9381 (2.4 GHz) and AR9380 (5 GHz). The SoC is picky about PCIe configuration under OpenWrt; for example, for any QCA9880v2 module, you will need to add "ath10k_pci irq_mode=1" to /etc/modules.d/ath10k. * [https://forum.openwrt.org/t/pci-e-external-storage-methods/41351 An example of an attempt to install USB and flash buses] * [https://github.com/btvmeshnet/hardware/blob/master/platforms/Meraki/MR24/README.md There is some speculation that this is not the case, due to the standard nature of the PCIe switch] ==Links of Interest== *[https://openwrt.org/toh/meraki/mr24 Some better images can be found on the '''OpenWrt''' wiki page] ===Reviews=== *[http://www.insearchoftech.com/2012/03/25/inside-wireless-hardware-part-1/ Inside Wireless Hardware on '''InSearchofTech'''] :Cisco Meraki MR24 ==Flashing== {{Flashnotice}} ===Flashing OpenWrt=== {{OpenWrt |techdata = https://openwrt.org/toh/hwdata/meraki/meraki_mr24 |wikipage = https://openwrt.org/toh/meraki/mr24 |forumpage = https://forum.openwrt.org/viewtopic.php?id=62436 |github = |target = apm821xx |subtarget = nand |arch = powerpc_464fp |support_commit_id = a57d6e2d47688cfa392d6ea7f36ae6f9d84affc5 |support_started_version = 17.01.0 |current_supported_version = 25.12.0 |last_supported_version = |image_too_big = |unsupportedfuncntions = |lan_hardware = |lan_comment = |wlan_hardware = Atheros AR9340 (PCIe), Atheros AR9280 (PCIe) |wlan_comment = |usb_sata_comment = |inst_method = U-Boot TFTP + serial recovery, see devicepage |inst_comment = |rec_method = U-Boot TFTP + serial recovery, see |rec_comment = |comment = }} {{SCollapse | git • >> | 
apm821xx: add support for the Cisco Meraki MR24
This patch adds support for the Cisco Meraki MR24 Access point
to the apm821xx target.

Board:		MR24 - Meraki MR24 Cloud Managed Access Point
CPU:		APM82181 SoC 800 MHz (PLB=200 OPB=100 EBC=100)
Flash size:	32MiB
RAM Size:	128MiB
Wireless:	Atheros AR9380 5.0GHz + Atheros AR9380 2.4GHz
Ethernet ports:	1x Gigabit Atheros AR8035

WARNING: The serial port needs a TTL/RS-232 v3.3 level converter!
